headline: Arauco Confirms $470M Sale of Forestry Assets in Maule to Reduce Debt
summary: Arauco has confirmed the sale of $470 million in forestry assets in Maule, aimed at reducing debt and strengthening its financial position amid investments in Brazil.
why: Asset divestments by large forestry and pulp producers improve corporate balance sheets and fund large-scale international capital projects.

impacts.name: Arauco
impacts.why: Monetizing non-core forestry assets reduces overall corporate indebtedness and frees capital.
